android.desc:
Don't wait for the download to finish – start watching while it downloads!

🐼 Usenet Panda is a native Android Usenet downloader with built-in streaming and search. Pick a file, tap Stream, and play it in your favorite media player after a short buffering phase, while the rest of the file keeps downloading in the background.

IMPORTANT: Usenet Panda is a download client only. It does not provide any content, indexer accounts or Usenet access. You need your own Usenet provider (news server) and, optionally, your own indexer.

🎬 STREAM WHILE YOU DOWNLOAD
• Start playback within moments instead of waiting for the full download
• Works with media files and RAR archives
• Opens in the media player of your choice
• Live buffering progress in the app and in a notification

🔎 SEARCH, IMPORT, DOWNLOAD
• Search your indexer right inside the app
• Import .nzb files and archives of NZBs from your device
• Set an NZB folder: new .nzb files in it are imported automatically when the app starts
• Full download queue: pause, resume, reorder and cancel, with speed, progress and remaining time
• Download history with retry and cleanup
• Automatic par2 repair and unrar/7-zip extraction
• SSL/TLS connections to your news server

🗂️ YOUR FILES, YOUR PLACE
• Choose your download folder
• Export finished downloads to any folder or SD card via Android's file picker

📱 BUILT FOR ANDROID
• Runs the download engine locally on your device – no cloud service, no account to sign up for
• Notifications with pause/resume controls
• Backup and restore your servers and indexers
• Modern Material Design with light and dark theme

🏅 FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL ONE-TIME UPGRADE
Usenet Panda is free and supported by ads. Go Premium with a single one-time payment (no subscription) to unlock:
• No ads
• Unlimited parallel connections
• Multiple news servers
• Multiple indexers, searched all at once
• Automatic export of finished downloads to external storage

🚀 GETTING STARTED
1. Choose a download folder and allow notifications
2. Enter your Usenet provider's server details in Settings
3. Add an indexer, or open an .nzb file
4. Start the stream or download

❤️ Made with love in Vienna by an independent developer. Questions, feedback or bug reports? Get in touch via the developer contact on this page.
